 Watch the song 'Bulaye Chhathi Maa' from the Hindi movie 'Yeh Prem Mol Liya' starring Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari. 'Bulaye Chhathi Maa' is sung by Shreya Ghoshal and Keshav Anand, and music of the song is composed by Himesh Reshammiya. Lyrics of 'Yeh Prem Mol Liya' song 'Bulaye Chhathi Maa' are written by Manoj Muntashir Shukla.
